// layout data from my Figma design – main migration circles (blue outlines)
let blueOutlineCircles = [
  { x: 719,    y: 564,    d: 40    },
...
];

// layout data from Figma – used to place background turtles (darker, “past” migrations)
let blackOutlineCircles = [
  { x: 145.93, y: 408.78, d: 96.84 },
 ...
];

// Filled blue circles – I use them as “anchors” to pick suitable orbits for live turtles
let blueFilledCircles = [
  { x: 592,    y: 749,    d: 86  },
 ...
];

//  UTILS 
// Build an array of length n where each element is generated by fillFunction(i)
function buildArray(n, fillFunction) {
  let outputArray = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) outputArray.push(fillFunction(i));
  return outputArray;
}

// Remove the first occurrence of a value from an array (used when picking orbits)
function removeValueFromArray(arr, value) {
  for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
    if (arr[i] === value) {
      arr.splice(i, 1);
      return;
    }
  }
}

// Given a point (px, py) and a list of circle indices,
// find the circle whose radius matches that point the best.
// This lets me attach a turtle to the orbit that “feels closest” to a design anchor from Figma.
function chooseBestOrbitFromList(px, py, orbitIndexList) {
  if (!orbitIndexList || orbitIndexList.length === 0) return 0;

  let bestIdx = orbitIndexList[0];
  let bestDiff = Infinity;

  for (let k = 0; k < orbitIndexList.length; k++) {
    let idx = orbitIndexList[k];
    let c = blueOutlineCircles[idx];
    let circleR = c.d / 2;

    let distToCenter = dist(px, py, c.x, c.y);
    let diff = abs(distToCenter - circleR);

    if (diff < bestDiff) {
      bestDiff = diff;
      bestIdx = idx;
    }
  }
  return bestIdx;
}

// Pick an angle theta along a circle so that the turtle actually appears inside the canvas.
// This avoids spawning big turtles half-offscreen.
function pickThetaInsideCanvas(cx, cy, r, margin) {
  let candidates = [];
  for (let a = 0; a < TWO_PI; a += 0.01) {
    let x = cx + cos(a) * r;
    let y = cy + sin(a) * r;
    if (x > margin && x < width - margin && y > margin && y < height - margin) {
      candidates.push(a);
    }
  }
  if (candidates.length === 0) return random(TWO_PI);
  return candidates[floor(random(candidates.length))];
}

// STATE
let liveTurtles = [];    // turtles currently migrating on the blue orbits (foreground)
let deadBgTurtles = [];  // background turtles, like traces of past migrations
let plastics = [];       // plastic chunks dropped by the viewer
let blobs = [];          // other tiny life forms, just strokes drifting around
let turtleImg = null;    // turtle SVG image

let trashDrops = 0;      // how many times the viewer has dropped plastic
let isGameOver = false;  // becomes true when we “kill” the ecosystem
let isCleaning = false;  // becomes true when the viewer clicks Clean
let dangerLevel = 0;     // 0 → 1, drives all the blue → red transitions

let btnClean = null;     // p5 button for “Clean”
let domMoreBtn = null;   // HTML button “More >” from the main page

// Music toggle state
let musicBtn = null;
let isMusicOn = true;
let ambientStarted = false; // first click → unlock audio → start ambient

// SOUNDS
// Each variable holds one sound asset from the /assets folder

let sEat = null;       // uc.wav – when a turtle swallows plastic and dies
let sDrop = null;      // bubble.wav – feedback sound for dropping plastic
let sHover = null;     // turtle slide.wav – when you hover and turtles “dash” away
let sTurnRed = null;   // turn red.wav – when the whole scene switches into danger mode
let sClean = null;     // underwater.wav – when you hit Clean
let sAmbient = null;   // ambient music with noise.wav – looping background ambience

// CONFIG
// Tunable constants that control look and feel

let REMOVE_LIVE_TURTLE_INDEX = -1; // if >= 0, hides a specific live turtle; -1 means keep all
let OUTER_LIVE_ORBIT_INDEX = 11;   // main outer orbit used for the biggest turtle

let LIVE_BASE_SIZE = 70;
let LIVE_TURTLE_SIZE_MULTS = [5.0, 4.0, 2.3, 0.7, 0.5, 2.0]; // size multipliers per turtle
let LIVE_MIN_SIZE = 42;

let LIVE_ORBIT_POOL = [1, 3, 5, 7, 9]; // candidate orbits for the other live turtles

// Background turtles – more subtle, drifting behind everything
let DEAD_BG_COUNT = 40;
let BG_SCALE = 1.15;
let BG_TINT_R = 10,  BG_TINT_G = 60,  BG_TINT_B = 180, BG_TINT_A = 95;   // base blue tint
let DEAD_TINT_R = 5, DEAD_TINT_G = 40, DEAD_TINT_B = 140, DEAD_TINT_A = 210; // stronger tint

// Plastic
let PLASTIC_CLUSTER = 18; // every click spawns a cluster of ~18 plastic pieces

// Hover + collision tuning
let HOVER_RADIUS_PAD = 28;        // extra radius around turtle for hover detection
let HOVER_SPEED_BOOST = 20.0;     // when hovered, turtles move 20× faster to dodge
let HEAD_OFFSET_RATIO = 0.38;     // how far from center to treat as the turtle's “head”
let COLLISION_PAD = 4;            // small padding for collision sensitivity

// Turtle image is drawn facing up by default → rotate 90° so it faces along the orbit
var TURTLE_ROT_OFFSET = Math.PI / 2;

// Simple game state
let TRASH_DROP_LIMIT = 10;     // if viewer drops more than 10 times → “game over”
let CLEAN_FADE_SPEED = 10;     // how fast plastic fades during cleaning
let DANGER_FADE_SPEED = 0.06;  // how fast dangerLevel lerps to 0 or 1

// BLOBS – tiny organic streaks in the background, drawn as rounded strokes
const BLOB_COUNT = 26;
const BLOB_MIN_LEN = 40;
const BLOB_MAX_LEN = 120;
const BLOB_MIN_THICK = 6;
const BLOB_MAX_THICK = 14;

// QUOTES + TEXT ORBITS 
// Circular text that carries quotes + credits around certain orbits

let quotes = [
  "Their survival is our responsibility; we must create hope.",
  "Even a single piece of plastic can kill a turtle.",
  "Vu Minh Duc · S4032402 · Maciawa",
  "SDG 14 · Life Below Water · If the ocean dies, we die"
];

// Layout configuration per text orbit: which circle, what size, speed, spacing...
let textOrbits = [
  {
    circleIndex: 10,
    quoteIndex: 3,
    size: 90,
    speed: 0.00160,
    start: -Math.PI * 0.10,
    spacing: 1.35
  },
  {
    circleIndex: 8,
    quoteIndex: 0,
    size: 68,
    speed: -0.00170,
    start: -Math.PI * 0.55,
    spacing: 1.08
  },
  {
    circleIndex: 6,
    quoteIndex: 1,
    size: 30,
    speed: 0.00175,
    start: Math.PI * 0.85,
    spacing: 1.14
  },
  {
    circleIndex: 4,
    quoteIndex: 2,
    size: 20,
    speed: -0.00185,
    start: Math.PI * 0.75,
    spacing: 1.18
  }
];

// Current angle offset for each text orbit
let orbitAngles = new Array(textOrbits.length).fill(0);

// Helper to check if a certain blue circle index is already reserved for text
function isCircleUsedByText(idx) {
  for (let i = 0; i < textOrbits.length; i++) {
    if (textOrbits[i].circleIndex === idx) return true;
  }
  return false;
}

// PRELOAD 
// Load image + sounds before setup()

function preload() {
  // Use SVG to keep the turtle sharp at large sizes
  turtleImg = loadImage(
    "assets/turtle.svg",
    () => console.log("✅ turtle.svg loaded"),
    () => { console.log("❌ FAILED to load assets/turtle.svg"); turtleImg = null; }
  );

  soundFormats("wav");

  // Load all the sound effects. If any fails, I just ignore it so the sketch keeps running.
  sEat      = loadSound("assets/uc.wav",                       () => {}, () => {});
  sDrop     = loadSound("assets/bubble.wav",                   () => {}, () => {});
  sHover    = loadSound("assets/turtle slide.wav",             () => {}, () => {});
  sTurnRed  = loadSound("assets/turn red.wav",                 () => {}, () => {});
  sClean    = loadSound("assets/underwater.wav",               () => {}, () => {});
  sAmbient  = loadSound("assets/ambient music with noise.wav", () => {}, () => {});
}

// SETUP
// Set up canvas, fonts, initial turtles, blobs, UI buttons and sound levels

function setup() {
  createCanvas(1920, 1080);
  frameRate(30);

  imageMode(CENTER);
  angleMode(RADIANS);
  textFont("Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono");

  // “More >” button comes from the static HTML overlay
  domMoreBtn = document.getElementById("btnMore");

  // Initialise all world entities
  initLiveTurtles();
  initDeadBgTurtles();
  initBlobs();

  // Clean button – visually similar to “More”, but on the left
  btnClean = createButton("Clean");
  btnClean.position(20, height * 0.06 - 20);
  btnClean.style("padding", "0.4vw 1.25vw");
  btnClean.style("border-radius", "50vw");
  btnClean.style("border", "2px solid #1E97F2");
  btnClean.style("background", "transparent");
  btnClean.style("color", "#FFFFFF");
  btnClean.style("font-size", "0.94vw");
  btnClean.style("cursor", "pointer");
  btnClean.style("font-family", "Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono, monospace");
  btnClean.style("z-index", "500");
  btnClean.mousePressed(startCleaning); // click → enter “cleaning” mode

  // Small music icon button in the bottom right corner
  let rightMargin = width * 0.0208;
  let iconSize = 40;
  musicBtn = createImg("assets/musicon.svg", "toggle music");
  musicBtn.position(
    width - rightMargin - iconSize,
    height - height * 0.06 - iconSize / 2
  );
  musicBtn.size(iconSize, iconSize);
  musicBtn.style("cursor", "pointer");
  musicBtn.mousePressed(toggleMusic);

  // Configure volume & looping for audio
  if (sAmbient) {
    sAmbient.setLoop(true);
    sAmbient.setVolume(0.35);
  }
  if (sDrop)    sDrop.setVolume(0.55);
  if (sEat)     sEat.setVolume(0.65);
  if (sHover)   sHover.setVolume(0.5);
  if (sTurnRed) sTurnRed.setVolume(0.7);
  if (sClean)   sClean.setVolume(0.7);
}

// PATH HELPERS 
// Keep a turtle on its circular migration path with some “wobble”

function setTurtlePosOnPath(t) {
  let wobble = sin(t.theta * t.wobbleFreq + t.wobblePhase) * t.wobbleAmp;
  let r = t.pathR + wobble;

  t.x = t.pathCx + cos(t.theta) * r;
  t.y = t.pathCy + sin(t.theta) * r;
}

// INIT 
// Initialise live turtles, background turtles and blobs

function initLiveTurtles() {
  liveTurtles = [];

  let orbitPool = LIVE_ORBIT_POOL.slice();
  orbitPool = orbitPool.filter(idx => !isCircleUsedByText(idx));      // avoid text orbits
  orbitPool = orbitPool.filter(i => i !== OUTER_LIVE_ORBIT_INDEX);    // keep outer ring for the hero turtle

  let maxLive = 1 + orbitPool.length; // one turtle on the big outer orbit + others on inner ones

  for (let i = 0; i < maxLive; i++) {
    let orbitIdx;

    if (i === 0) {
      // First (largest) turtle goes on the outermost orbit
      orbitIdx = OUTER_LIVE_ORBIT_INDEX;
    } else {
      // Other turtles choose the best matching orbit based on blueFilledCircles
      let src = blueFilledCircles[i] || { x: width / 2, y: height / 2 };
      orbitIdx = chooseBestOrbitFromList(src.x, src.y, orbitPool);
      removeValueFromArray(orbitPool, orbitIdx);
    }

    let bestCircle = blueOutlineCircles[orbitIdx];

    let mult = (LIVE_TURTLE_SIZE_MULTS[i] !== undefined)
      ? LIVE_TURTLE_SIZE_MULTS[i]
      : 1.0;
    let size = LIVE_BASE_SIZE * mult;
    if (size < LIVE_MIN_SIZE) size = LIVE_MIN_SIZE;

    let t = {
      pathCx: bestCircle.x,
      pathCy: bestCircle.y,
      pathR: bestCircle.d / 2,

      theta: random(TWO_PI),

      baseSpeed: random(0.0012, 0.0020),
      speed: 0,

      wobbleAmp: size * random(0.06, 0.14),
      wobbleFreq: random(0.8, 1.8),
      wobblePhase: random(TWO_PI),

      size: size,
      isDead: false,

      x: 0, y: 0,
      angle: 0,
      wasHovered: false
    };

    t.speed = t.baseSpeed;

    // For the big outer turtle, choose a theta that ensures it fits inside the canvas
    if (i === 0) {
      let rMax = t.pathR + abs(t.wobbleAmp);
      t.theta = pickThetaInsideCanvas(
        t.pathCx,
        t.pathCy,
        rMax,
        t.size * 0.6 + 30
      );
    }

    setTurtlePosOnPath(t);
    liveTurtles.push(t);
  }
}

function initDeadBgTurtles() {
  let count = DEAD_BG_COUNT;

  let len = blackOutlineCircles.length;
  let step = floor(len / count);
  if (step < 1) step = 1;

  // Each background turtle is loosely attached to one black circle,
  // with some jitter and gentle floating to create texture.
  deadBgTurtles = buildArray(count, (i) => {
    let idx = (i * step + floor(step * 0.45)) % len;
    let src = blackOutlineCircles[idx];

    let jx = random(-55, 55);
    let jy = random(-45, 45);

    let size = src.d * BG_SCALE * random(0.78, 1.08);

    return {
      x: src.x + jx,
      y: src.y + jy,
      baseX: src.x + jx,
      baseY: src.y + jy,
      size: size,

      floatOffsetY: random(-110, 110),
      floatSpeedY: random(-0.50, 0.50),
      floatRangeY: random(110, 220),

      floatOffsetX: random(-80, 80),
      floatSpeedX: random(-0.35, 0.35),
      floatRangeX: random(80, 160),

      rotPhase: random(TWO_PI),
      rotAmp: random(0.02, 0.06)
    };
  });
}

// Create one blob starting from the edge of the canvas and moving inward
function createRandomBlob() {
  let edge = floor(random(4));
  let x, y, angle;
  let margin = 80;

  if (edge === 0) {           // left → right
    x = -margin;
    y = random(height);
    angle = random(-PI / 4, PI / 4);
  } else if (edge === 1) {    // right → left
    x = width + margin;
    y = random(height);
    angle = PI + random(-PI / 4, PI / 4);
  } else if (edge === 2) {    // top → bottom
    x = random(width);
    y = -margin;
    angle = PI / 2 + random(-PI / 4, PI / 4);
  } else {                    // bottom → top
    x = random(width);
    y = height + margin;
    angle = -PI / 2 + random(-PI / 4, PI / 4);
  }

  let baseSpeed = random(3.0, 5.0); // quite fast, but small and subtle
  let length = random(BLOB_MIN_LEN, BLOB_MAX_LEN);
  let thickness = random(BLOB_MIN_THICK, BLOB_MAX_THICK);

  return {
    x,
    y,
    angle,
    baseSpeed,
    length,
    thickness,
    phase: random(TWO_PI),
    curLength: length
  };
}

function initBlobs() {
  blobs = buildArray(BLOB_COUNT, () => createRandomBlob());
}

//  HELPERS 
// Utility functions for game-over and cleaning logic

// Check if all live turtles are dead
function areAllLiveDead() {
  for (let i = 0; i < liveTurtles.length; i++) {
    if (!liveTurtles[i].isDead) return false;
  }
  return true;
}

// Turn the whole system into red mode 
function triggerGameOver() {
  if (!isGameOver) {
    isGameOver = true;
    if (sTurnRed) sTurnRed.play();
  }
}

// When Clean is pressed, enter cleaning mode and play the underwater sound
function startCleaning() {
  isCleaning = true;
  isGameOver = false;
  if (sClean) sClean.play();
}

// Once all plastic is gone, reset the state (turtles revived, counter reset)
function finishCleaningAndReset() {
  isCleaning = false;
  trashDrops = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < liveTurtles.length; i++) {
    liveTurtles[i].isDead = false;
  }
}

// UPDATE 
// Per-frame update functions: movement, collisions, text, danger level, etc.

// Update motion for live turtles, handle hover boost and plastic collisions
function updateLiveTurtles() {
  for (let i = 0; i < liveTurtles.length; i++) {
    let t = liveTurtles[i];
    if (t.isDead) continue;

    let hoverRadius = t.size * 0.6 + HOVER_RADIUS_PAD;
    let dMouse = dist(mouseX, mouseY, t.x, t.y);
    let isHovered = dMouse < hoverRadius;

    // On first hover, play a small “slide” sound as the turtle dashes away
    if (isHovered && !t.wasHovered && !isCleaning) {
      if (sHover) sHover.play();
    }

    // Hover → temporarily multiply its angular speed so it escapes faster
    if (isHovered) {
      t.speed = t.baseSpeed * HOVER_SPEED_BOOST;
    } else {
      // When not hovered, smoothly return to the baseSpeed
      t.speed = lerp(t.speed, t.baseSpeed, 0.10);
    }

    t.wasHovered = isHovered;

    // Move along the orbit by decreasing theta
    t.theta -= t.speed;
    setTurtlePosOnPath(t);

    // Orientation is aligned with the path direction
    t.angle = t.theta - HALF_PI;

    checkHeadCollision(t);
  }
}

// Check if a turtle's head touches any plastic piece → mark it as dead
function checkHeadCollision(t) {
  if (plastics.length === 0) return;

  let headOffset = t.size * HEAD_OFFSET_RATIO;
  let headX = t.x + cos(t.angle) * headOffset;
  let headY = t.y + sin(t.angle) * headOffset;

  for (let j = 0; j < plastics.length; j++) {
    let p = plastics[j];

    let threshold = p.size * 0.70 + COLLISION_PAD;
    let d = dist(headX, headY, p.x, p.y);

    if (d < threshold) {
      t.isDead = true;          // this turtle “dies” from plastic
      if (sEat && !isCleaning) sEat.play();
      return;
    }
  }
}

// Gentle floating for background turtles, purely decorative
function updateDeadBgTurtles() {
  for (let i = 0; i < deadBgTurtles.length; i++) {
    let t = deadBgTurtles[i];

    t.floatOffsetY += t.floatSpeedY;
    if (t.floatOffsetY > t.floatRangeY || t.floatOffsetY < -t.floatRangeY) {
      t.floatSpeedY *= -1;
    }

    t.floatOffsetX += t.floatSpeedX;
    if (t.floatOffsetX > t.floatRangeX || t.floatOffsetX < -t.floatRangeX) {
      t.floatSpeedX *= -1;
    }

    t.x = t.baseX + t.floatOffsetX;
    t.y = t.baseY + t.floatOffsetY;
  }
}

// Update the position of plastic pieces, and fade them out during cleaning
function updatePlastics() {
  for (let i = plastics.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    let p = plastics[i];

    let time = frameCount * p.floatSpeed + p.phase;
    p.x = p.baseX + sin(time) * p.floatAmpX;
    p.y = p.baseY + cos(time) * p.floatAmpY;

    // In cleaning mode, gradually reduce alpha until the plastic disappears
    if (isCleaning) {
      p.alpha -= CLEAN_FADE_SPEED;
      if (p.alpha <= 0) plastics.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }

  // When we are cleaning and all plastic is gone → reset everything
  if (isCleaning && plastics.length === 0) {
    finishCleaningAndReset();
  }
}

// Add some drama: when danger goes up, the text orbits spin faster
function updateOrbitText() {
  let speedMult = 1 + dangerLevel * 25;
  for (let i = 0; i < textOrbits.length; i++) {
    orbitAngles[i] += textOrbits[i].speed * speedMult;
  }
}

// Smoothly interpolate dangerLevel towards 0 (safe) or 1 (full red mode)
function updateDangerLevel() {
  let target = (isGameOver ? 1 : 0);
  dangerLevel = lerp(dangerLevel, target, DANGER_FADE_SPEED);
}

// Update blobs – small stroke organisms in the background
function updateBlobs() {
  let margin = 120;

  for (let i = 0; i < blobs.length; i++) {
    let b = blobs[i];

    // When the scene is fully red / game over, blobs freeze completely (no wobble, no motion)
    if (isGameOver && dangerLevel > 0.9) {
      b.curLength = b.length;
      continue;
    }

    // Normal state: blobs gently breathe in/out by changing their length
    let wobble = 0.25 * sin(frameCount * 0.04 + b.phase);
    b.curLength = b.length * (1 + wobble);

    // Move along their angle
    let speed = b.baseSpeed;
    b.x += cos(b.angle) * speed;
    b.y += sin(b.angle) * speed;

    // If a blob escapes outside the screen, respawn a new one
    if (
      b.x < -margin || b.x > width + margin ||
      b.y < -margin || b.y > height + margin
    ) {
      blobs[i] = createRandomBlob();
    }
  }
}

// INTERACTION 
// Mouse interaction, audio unlocking, plastic-dropping and music toggling

// Check if a click hits any turtle (live or background)
function isClickOnAnyTurtle(px, py) {
  for (let i = 0; i < liveTurtles.length; i++) {
    let t = liveTurtles[i];
    let rr = t.size * 0.35;
    if (dist(px, py, t.x, t.y) < rr) return true;
  }

  for (let i = 0; i < deadBgTurtles.length; i++) {
    let t = deadBgTurtles[i];
    let rr = t.size * 0.35;
    if (dist(px, py, t.x, t.y) < rr) return true;
  }

  return false;
}

// Browsers block autoplay audio → I use the first click to start looping ambient sound
function ensureAmbientPlaying() {
  if (!sAmbient) return;
  if (!ambientStarted && isMusicOn) {
    if (!sAmbient.isPlaying()) {
      sAmbient.loop();
    }
    ambientStarted = true;
  }
}

function mousePressed() {
  // First click: unlock audio and start ambient sound if needed
  ensureAmbientPlaying();

  // Only drop plastic if I’m not clicking on a turtle directly
  if (!isClickOnAnyTurtle(mouseX, mouseY)) {
    addPlasticAtPoint(mouseX, mouseY);
  }
}

// Toggle ambient music on/off and swap the icon
function toggleMusic() {
  if (!sAmbient) return;

  if (isMusicOn) {
    isMusicOn = false;
    sAmbient.pause();
    if (musicBtn) musicBtn.attribute("src", "assets/musicoff.svg");
  } else {
    isMusicOn = true;
    ensureAmbientPlaying();
    if (musicBtn) musicBtn.attribute("src", "assets/musicon.svg");
  }
}

// Spawn a cluster of plastic pieces around the click position
function addPlasticAtPoint(px, py) {
  trashDrops += 1; // used later to trigger game over

  if (sDrop && !isCleaning) sDrop.play();

  for (let j = 0; j < PLASTIC_CLUSTER; j++) {
    let angle = random(TWO_PI);
    let r = random(20, 80);

    let x = px + cos(angle) * r;
    let y = py + sin(angle) * r;

    let size = random(6, 14);

    // Randomise plastic shape: circle / square / triangle
    let shapeType;
    let rShape = random();
    if (rShape < 0.33) shapeType = "circle";
    else if (rShape < 0.66) shapeType = "square";
    else shapeType = "triangle";

    plastics.push({
      baseX: x, baseY: y,
      x: x, y: y,
      size: size,
      shapeType: shapeType,
      phase: random(TWO_PI),
      floatSpeed: random(0.012, 0.028),
      floatAmpX: random(1.5, 5),
      floatAmpY: random(1.5, 6),
      alpha: 255
    });
  }
}

// DRAW HELPERS
// Rendering helpers for turtles, plastic, circular text and blobs

// Draw one turtle, with different tinting for live / dead / background
// and a smooth transition from blue to red as dangerLevel increases.
function drawTurtleImage(x, y, size, angle, isDead, isBackground, extraOffset) {
  if (extraOffset === undefined) extraOffset = 0;

  // Fallback: if the SVG fails to load, draw a simple ellipse instead
  if (!turtleImg) {
    push();
    translate(x, y);
    rotate(angle);
    noStroke();
    fill(isBackground ? 30 : (isDead ? 70 : 200), 160);
    ellipse(0, 0, size * 0.72, size * 0.52);
    pop();
    return;
  }

  push();
  translate(x, y);
  rotate(angle + TURTLE_ROT_OFFSET + extraOffset);

  let r, g, b, a;

  if (isBackground) {
    // Background turtles slowly shift from cool blue towards red
    r = lerp(BG_TINT_R, 255, dangerLevel);
    g = lerp(BG_TINT_G, 0,   dangerLevel);
    b = lerp(BG_TINT_B, 0,   dangerLevel);
    a = lerp(BG_TINT_A, 220, dangerLevel);
    tint(r, g, b, a);
  } else if (isDead) {
    // Dead turtles are darker and go red as danger increases
    r = lerp(DEAD_TINT_R, 255, dangerLevel);
    g = lerp(DEAD_TINT_G, 0,   dangerLevel);
    b = lerp(DEAD_TINT_B, 0,   dangerLevel);
    a = lerp(DEAD_TINT_A, 230, dangerLevel);
    tint(r, g, b, a);
  } else {
    // Live turtles keep their original colour, but are tinted red in danger mode
    if (dangerLevel > 0.01) {
      let gCol = lerp(255, 0, dangerLevel);
      let bCol = lerp(255, 0, dangerLevel);
      tint(255, gCol, bCol, 255);
    } else {
      noTint();
    }
  }

  image(turtleImg, 0, 0, size, size);
  noTint();
  pop();
}

// Draw all plastic shapes, also shifting from blueish to red as danger grows
function drawPlastics() {
  noStroke();
  for (let i = 0; i < plastics.length; i++) {
    let p = plastics[i];

    let rr = lerp(0,   255, dangerLevel);
    let gg = lerp(120, 0,   dangerLevel);
    let bb = lerp(255, 0,   dangerLevel);

    fill(rr, gg, bb, p.alpha);

    let s = p.size;

    if (p.shapeType === "circle") {
      circle(p.x, p.y, s);
    } else if (p.shapeType === "square") {
      rectMode(CENTER);
      rect(p.x, p.y, s, s);
    } else {
      triangle(
        p.x, p.y - s * 0.7,
        p.x - s * 0.6, p.y + s * 0.4,
        p.x + s * 0.6, p.y + s * 0.4
      );
    }
  }
}

// Draw one circular text string letter by letter, following the circle
function drawTextOnCircle(str, cx, cy, r, startAngle, textSizePx, spacingFactor, useNotable) {
  push();
  translate(cx, cy);

  textSize(textSizePx);
  textAlign(CENTER, CENTER);

  if (dangerLevel > 0.01) {
    // In danger mode, text turns red with no stroke (as requested)
    noStroke();
    let gCol = lerp(255, 0, dangerLevel);
    let bCol = lerp(255, 0, dangerLevel);
    fill(255, gCol, bCol);
  } else {
    stroke(0, 170);
    strokeWeight(textSizePx * 0.08);
    fill(255);
  }

  // Compute angular spacing based on radius and custom spacing factor
  let baseSpacing = textSizePx * 0.64;
  let desiredSpacing = baseSpacing * spacingFactor;

  let step = desiredSpacing / r;
  let maxStep = (TWO_PI * 0.92) / max(1, str.length);
  if (step > maxStep) step = maxStep;

  let totalAngle = str.length * step;
  let a = startAngle - totalAngle / 2;

  for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i++) {
    let ch = str.charAt(i);

    let x = cos(a) * r;
    let y = sin(a) * r;

    if (useNotable) {
      textFont("Notable");
    } else {
      textFont("Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono");
    }

    push();
    translate(x, y);
    rotate(a + HALF_PI); // orient the letter tangentially to the circle
    text(ch, 0, 0);
    pop();

    a += step;
  }

  pop();
}

// Draw all quote orbits (quotes + credits)
function drawQuoteOrbits() {
  for (let i = 0; i < textOrbits.length; i++) {
    let o = textOrbits[i];
    let c = blueOutlineCircles[o.circleIndex];
    let rr = c.d / 2;

    let str = quotes[o.quoteIndex];
    let startAngle = o.start + orbitAngles[i];

    let useNotable = (o.quoteIndex === 3);

    drawTextOnCircle(
      str,
      c.x,
      c.y,
      rr,
      startAngle,
      o.size,
      o.spacing,
      useNotable
    );
  }
}

// Draw the tiny rounded “blob” strokes that represent other life forms in the water
function drawBlobs() {
  strokeCap(ROUND);

  for (let i = 0; i < blobs.length; i++) {
    let b = blobs[i];

    // Blobs also travel from blue to red and get more opaque in danger mode
    let r = lerp(BG_TINT_R, 255, dangerLevel);
    let g = lerp(BG_TINT_G, 0,   dangerLevel);
    let bb = lerp(BG_TINT_B, 0,  dangerLevel);
    let a = lerp(BG_TINT_A, 230, dangerLevel);

    stroke(r, g, bb, a);
    strokeWeight(b.thickness);

    push();
    translate(b.x, b.y);
    rotate(b.angle);
    line(-b.curLength / 2, 0, b.curLength / 2, 0);
    pop();
  }
}

// MAIN DRAW 
// Main loop: update all logic → draw layers in the correct order

function draw() {
  background(0);

  // Only check for red when not in cleaning mode
  if (!isCleaning) {
    if (trashDrops > TRASH_DROP_LIMIT) triggerGameOver();
    if (areAllLiveDead()) triggerGameOver();
  }

  // Update world state
  updateDangerLevel();
  updatePlastics();
  updateDeadBgTurtles();
  updateLiveTurtles();
  updateOrbitText();
  updateBlobs();

  // UI styling: buttons and music icon also react to dangerLevel (blue → red)
  let br = lerp(30, 255, dangerLevel);
  let bg = lerp(151, 0,   dangerLevel);
  let bb = lerp(242, 0,   dangerLevel);

  if (domMoreBtn) {
    domMoreBtn.style.borderColor = `rgb(${br},${bg},${bb})`;
    domMoreBtn.style.color = (dangerLevel > 0.01) ? "#FF0000" : "#1E97F2";
  }

  if (btnClean) {
    btnClean.style("border", `2px solid rgb(${br},${bg},${bb})`);
    btnClean.style("color", dangerLevel > 0.01 ? "#FF0000" : "#FFFFFF");
  }

  if (musicBtn) {
    // In danger mode, slightly shift the hue of the music icon so it feels “infected” too
    if (dangerLevel > 0.01) {
      musicBtn.style("filter", "hue-rotate(-40deg) saturate(1.6)");
    } else {
      musicBtn.style("filter", "none");
    }
  }

  //  RENDER ORDER (from back to front) 
  // 1. Blobs in the far background
  drawBlobs();

  // 2. Background turtles
  for (let i = 0; i < deadBgTurtles.length; i++) {
    let t = deadBgTurtles[i];
    let rot = sin(frameCount * 0.01 + t.rotPhase) * t.rotAmp;
    drawTurtleImage(t.x, t.y, t.size, rot, true, true, -TURTLE_ROT_OFFSET);
  }

  // 3. Migration orbits (blue circles) – also fade towards red
  noFill();
  stroke(
    lerp(30, 255, dangerLevel),
    lerp(151, 0,   dangerLevel),
    lerp(242, 0,   dangerLevel)
  );
  strokeWeight(2);

  for (let i = 0; i < blueOutlineCircles.length; i++) {
    if (!isCircleUsedByText(i)) {
      let c = blueOutlineCircles[i];
      circle(c.x, c.y, c.d);
    }
  }

  // 4. Plastic pieces
  drawPlastics();

  // 5. Live turtles
  for (let i = 0; i < liveTurtles.length; i++) {
    if (i === REMOVE_LIVE_TURTLE_INDEX) continue;

    let t = liveTurtles[i];
    if (isCleaning && t.isDead) continue;

    drawTurtleImage(t.x, t.y, t.size, t.angle, t.isDead, false, 0);
  }

  // 6. Circular text (quotes + SDG + credit)
  drawQuoteOrbits();
}
